summary: Skipped without repository mutation because the parent-supplied anonymous transcript helper reported captions unavailable after all three bounded client attempts.

evidence.claim: The complete ephemeral helper output reports status unavailable with reason_code youtube_transcript_unavailable after three bounded attempts; WEB, ANDROID, and IOS each failed with ModuleNotFoundError. No chunks or segments were returned.

The curated YouTube protocol requires a terminal skipped result with reason_code youtube_transcript_unavailable and no metadata-only analysis or structured/wiki mutations when all bounded caption attempts are unavailable.
